description: This class manages JWT-based single sign-on authentication between OFBiz applications, including token creation, validation, and user login handling.

classes.name: JWTManager
classes.description: Handles JWT token creation, validation, and user login management for OFBiz's single sign-on system.

methods.name: checkJWTLogin
methods.description: Preprocessor event that verifies JWT token from request headers, retrieves user info, and performs login if valid.

methods.name: getJWTKey
methods.description: Retrieves the secret key used for JWT signing, optionally with a salt.

methods.name: getAuthenticationToken
methods.description: Authenticates user via username/password and generates a JWT token.

methods.name: getHeaderAuthBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates a JWT token with a secret key and returns claims or error.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates a JWT token using delegator and salt to recreate the key.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with claims and expiration time.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with claims, expiration time, and custom key salt.

methods.name: checkTenant
methods.description: Verifies tenant context for user login, adjusting delegator if needed.

methods.name: storeUserlogin
methods.description: Stores user login info in the database.

methods.name: getUserlogin
methods.description: Retrieves user login details from database based on JWT claims.

methods.name: validateJwtToken
methods.description: Validates JWT token and logs warning if invalid.
